command_closure.implementation: The existing queue is promoted to public IsleGameCommandPool/Queue and isle_game_command_send/commands/release, not copied into a second bus or retained under compatibility aliases. Services installs source default command processing on new native objects; custom update callbacks can explicitly process the same queue. Per-object custom handler/send and native-update-link send use that queue. Native retirement callback is outside source callback execution, after process joins, before record/queue recycling; handler-triggered deletion stops dispatch safely.
command_closure.source_menu_route: Menu reached senders remain absent; ohUpdateDefault uses NULL custom handler. Source-backed custom and broadcast operations are usable by real post-menu components, not invented menu producers.

native_boundary.arena: scene::Storage is the one nonmovable bare native owner, with one backing allocation, stable isle_arena and actual IsleGame. Construction creates no native game or profile; create/destroy/reset/reenter return actual native statuses. Successful destroy joins all callbacks before clearing the handle; reset rejects a live game; reentry reuses backing storage. Destruction cannot free under failed joins. Startup uses this same owner before/after deferred save initialization. ResourceView carries only native seed PoolCounts and borrowed scene::SpriteResource span. Menu Catalog retains setup callbacks/material/model/animation facts and owns generic sprite records without aliases. Native pools use actual sizeof/alignment, grow on empty lists and recycle only after retirement. Resource lookup is supplied, never hardcoded title Catalog.
native_boundary.continuations: C11 bridge contains native field/command operations. Services wait/end/self-delete use existing C continuation fences. No owning C++ automatic object or exception frame is retained across waits. Native retirement notification ensures externally deleted and deferred-self-deleted objects keep callback userdata and queue nodes until every process is joined.
native_boundary.source_prefix: Private bridge can reinsert only a new process-free equal-link/equal-priority object before a live peer. This recreates the title camera ahead of retained FX/UI prefix on repeated play, preserving OM process order without moving live process owners. Behavior tests exercise actual order and reject live-process reorder.
native_boundary.audio: Borrowed already initialized game_audio::Session controls are checked and retained; no mute, Null output, authored completion, retrace, task execution, or PCM ownership in Services.
native_boundary.math: Fade division follows double-promoted source duration expression then binary32 step/accumulator; sound calendars use binary32 grouping and unsigned tick/duration. Clamp/truncate only at original source publication points. Reached durations are positive; invalid zero/negative sound ramp duration and invalid fade duration fail before publication rather than divide by zero/execute undefined conversion.
native_boundary.failure: First diagnostic retained in fixed native storage. Native/audio errors are not exit requests. Full source calendars return false, not failure/progress. request_exit retains actual first GTL source result for the parent GTL owner, which must terminate its real update/draw loop.
native_boundary.render: Native SpriteDraw includes explicit source DL link, priority, camera tag and object identity independently from update metadata. Startup sprite factory retains exact tag-1/DL1 and optional source object ID14 for UI or31 for title caption. Head/tail moves insert before/after equal DL priorities. Full descriptor rebind/replacement explicitly selects immutable resource index or dynamic producer slot/generation, never mutates compiled bank pointers, and retains generation in sprite::Draw. Capacity and every native borrow preflight before first draw publication. Public native object metadata exposes flags; immediate object_set_flags implements source direct visibility assignment separately from queued hide/show builtins, preserving unrelated bits when the caller masks the metadata.
native_boundary.lifetime: Application State is noncopyable/nonmovable and owns profile path, one real GameOpenResult/Store lock, RNG, controller, byte title flags, 32-bit notices and independent scene latch. Construction does not open. Checked rejection evidence/lock is retained, initialization never retries/reopens, Startup borrows State and retirement/destruction does not release profile ownership. Explicit create_title requires initialized State and never replays boot/logo/open. Input/audio/game/arena/resources outlive Services and actual graphics completion. Scene destruction never drains or restarts persistent audio.
native_boundary.application_backing: One application-lifetime Storage alongside State is borrowed by every startup/title/name/Oak/course owner; Runtime no longer owns or reallocates backing storage. Final API is create/create_title(catalog,input,audio,State&,Storage&,raw_time) with no old capacity overload. Admission requires empty native Storage; native_owned records whether this Runtime created current content. After retire, later destruction of an old Runtime cannot destroy a new scene using the same backing. Parent fences actual graphics/readback before native retirement and destroys profile State last.
